card.name: The ending of 'transporters' in interaction text
card.fires_on: The final piece 'ers' of the word 'transporters' in drug-interaction and pharmacology text, usually just before a list such as P-glycoprotein or OATP1B1. Rarely, the last letter of an enzyme name such as Cet1p.

modes.label: transporters ending
modes.description: The closing 'ers' of 'transporters' when drugs are described as substrates or inhibitors of enzymes and transporters.

modes.label: Enzyme name ending
modes.description: The last letter of a protein name in an enzyme description, seen once.
